pages.title: File:Cây dây leo - Lianas 0911 07202026.jpg

ObjectName.value: Cây dây leo - Lianas 0911 07202026

ImageDescription.value: Lianas begin life on the forest floor where only receives only 1 percent to 2 percent of available sunlight. But they are much more clever than your average photosynthetic friends; instead of building their own structures, they wind their way up those or other trees, knitting intricate webs between trunks and branches. This method is so effective that sometimes these vines out-complete their host, gathering more light than big tree! -Information board in Côn Đảo National Park-

Artist.value: Le N Cat Tuong
